status: frozen after A8 and A9 survived the NBM0-A1 scan and before executing their scaling and energy-budget gates
purpose: Determine whether the two NBM0-A1 survivors can evade the linear radial theorem without becoming MOND/AQUAL, a ghost, an object-segmented nonadditive law, or an independent dark component.
premises_held_fixed: no per-object or object-class force parameters
at most four new global physical parameters
no astronomical parameter fit during derivation

A8_subfamilies.name: static local nonlinear flux law
A8_subfamilies.gate: flat outer speed and v_flat^4 proportional to baryonic mass without the AQUAL power

A8_subfamilies.name: algebraic nonlinear map of one inverse field
A8_subfamilies.gate: flat outer speed and square-root baryonic amplitude from one mass-linear X field

A8_subfamilies.name: nonlinear effective source charge
A8_subfamilies.gate: square-root total charge while remaining additive under arbitrary subdivision of the same matter distribution

A8_subfamilies.name: retarded nonlinear memory
A8_subfamilies.gate: unique cosmological initial state and no object-specific history variable; static limit must evade A8.1-A8.3

A9_subfamilies.name: canonical sourced scalar exterior energy
A9_subfamilies.gate: field energy comparable to missing lensing mass while direct fifth force remains order unity

A9_subfamilies.name: uniform negative-pressure vacuum in voids
A9_subfamilies.gate: broad inward galaxy support rather than an outward harmonic acceleration or shell-theorem cancellation

A9_subfamilies.name: nonminimal scalar curvature polarization
A9_subfamilies.gate: weak-field behavior not already in the linear scalar or nonlinear-flux branches

A9_subfamilies.name: independent basin condensate energy reservoir
A9_subfamilies.gate: remain a pure modified-gravity/void-pressure theory rather than a new gravitating dark component

loophole_expansion_rule: If A8 and A9 fail, admit one additional family only if it is not an additive force or algebraic response already covered. A boundary/constitutive gravitational-permittivity mechanism qualifies because it changes flux geometry.

prior_art_boundary.known_family: Refracted Gravity uses density-dependent gravitational permittivity and already claims galaxy and cluster dynamics; it is a benchmark, not an originality claim.
